boundary: Occurrence counts prove the event name ships in the CLI. They do not prove the provider emits the event for a given attempt; a treatment attempt missing any required event class aborts as missing_required_hook_event_class rather than being counted. Re-collect this evidence against the exact CLI version before freezing a measurement manifest.
method: Resolve the claude executable, read `claude --version`, then count literal ASCII occurrences of each event name in the resolved bundle bytes.
purpose: Direct external evidence that every hook event this suite registers exists in the provider CLI, so the claim does not rest only on this project's own frozen list.
